instruction.text: Tippe auf die Fragewörter in den Fragesätzen.

atoms.b: Basic asked Lilly, “((When)) is the chemistry exam?”
atoms.sound: Bashic asked Lilly. When is the chemistry exam?

atoms.b: Basic asked Lilly ((when)) the chemistry exam was.
atoms.sound: Bashic asked Lilly when the chemistry exam was.

atoms.b: Wenn eine Frage in der direkten Rede von einem ((++Fragewort Numeral)) eingeleitet wird, wird es in der indirekten Rede ((++übernommen verändert)).
atoms.sound: Wenn eine Frage in der direkten Rede von einem Fragewort eingeleitet wird, wird es in der indirekten Rede übernommen.

example.a:
She asked him, “Have you done your homework?”

She asked him whether he had done his homework.
example.sound: She asked him, Have you done your homework?” She asked him whether he had done his homework.

example.a:
He asked her, “Can you take a picture?”

He asked her if she could take a picture.
example.sound: He asked her, Can you take a picture? He asked her if she could take a picture.

hint.text: Entscheidungsfragen sind Fragen, auf die man mit „Ja“ oder mit „Nein“ antworten kann.

atoms.b: Man verwendet if oder whether in der indirekten Rede, wenn man eine ((++Entscheidungsfrage offene_Frage)) wiedergibt.
atoms.sound: Man verwendet  <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>if</voice> oder  <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>whether</voice> in der indirekten Rede, wenn man eine Entscheidungsfrage wiedergibt.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den indirekten Fragesatz, indem du das richtige Wort in die Lücken schreibst.

atoms.a: Madeleine asked, “Will we order food online?”
atoms.b: Madeleine asked ((if whether)) they would order food online.

atoms.a: Andrés asked, “Did you go to the dance practice?”
atoms.b: Andrés asked ((whether if)) she had gone to the dance practice.

atoms.a: Alice asked, “Can you repeat the question?”
atoms.b: Alice asked ((if whether)) he could repeat the question.

atoms.a: Daniel asked, “Would you like a piece of the chocolate cake?”
atoms.b: Daniel asked ((whether if)) she would like a piece of the chocolate cake.

atoms.a: David asked them, “Who ate the last slice of pizza?”
atoms.b: David asked them ((who)) had eaten the last slice of pizza.

atoms.a: She asked, “When does the birthday party start?”
atoms.b: She asked ((when)) the birthday party started.

atoms.a: He asked her, “Where will you go in the winter holidays?”
atoms.b: He asked her ((where)) she would go in the winter holidays.

atoms.a: Sara asked him, “What are your plans for the weekend.”
atoms.b: Sara asked him ((what)) his plans for the weekend were.
